finding.text: `ext/Chat/doc/Composer-notes.md` lists every composer hook (`on_live`, `on_send_start`, …) but not the new `on_out`, and `ext/Chat/doc/mic-notes.md`'s `## post_held` section doesn't mention `take_out()` or the `at` that the send now carries. A fresh agent reading the Chat docs won't learn how sent words reach the screen (readme/doc gap: Composer.js and Mic.js both changed).

`ext/Chat/doc/notes.md:69` says `patch_piece()` "redraw[s] its bubble". After this diff it swaps only that piece's node, and redraws the whole bubble only when the bubble is refined or the node is missing. The doc is stale on exactly the behaviour the fix depends on.

Polish item 3 asked for the `.catch` in `post_held` to be removed. The minion kept it, because `ChatPanel`'s own deliver can throw, and removed only the duplicate Sent-row write. The reason is given in the code and in commit f4c0d7eec. This is a justified departure (law 4), not a miss.

The fix covers the dictation `Widget` only. `ext/Chat/ChatPanel.js` uses the same composer without `on_out`, so its chat can still flicker. This is recorded in `doc/flicker.md` under "Not covered yet", but no task or ask was filed for it.
The sent words are drawn in the faded "raw" look: grey text on the peach bubble, `shots/after-clean-030.png`, roughly 3:1. They are readable, but fainter than settled text.
Polish items 4 and 5 in `polish/requirements.md` are the same ask written twice. It was done once, which is correct.
